Date on which an accumulated index reaches a threshold

Source: R/threshold.R
threshold_date.Rd

Accumulates daily (or hourly) index values in time order and returns the first date on which the running total reaches threshold. Typical uses are the date when a crop or pest reaches a degree-day requirement, or when a cultivar completes its chill requirement.

Usage

threshold_date(values, dates, threshold, na_action = c("propagate", "skip"))

Arguments

values

Numeric vector of index values per time step (not cumulative), for example the output of degree_days().

dates

Vector of Date (or POSIXct) of the same length, in increasing order.

threshold

Single number: requirement in the units of values.

na_action

"propagate" (default): if a missing value occurs before the threshold is reached, the result is NA, because the true date cannot be known. "skip": missing steps contribute zero (the date may then be late).

Value

A single date of the class of dates (NA if the threshold is not reached), with attribute "index" (position in dates).

Examples

dates <- seq(as.Date("2023-09-01"), by = "day", length.out = 10)
gdd <- c(2, 3, 5, 4, 6, 7, 3, 2, 8, 9)
threshold_date(gdd, dates, threshold = 20)
#> [1] "2023-09-05"
